  assert_equal([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], (1..5).to_a)
  assert_equal([1, 2, 3, 4], (1...5).to_a)

  end

  ##
  # call-seq:
  #    rng.to_a                   -> array
  #    rng.entries                -> array
  #
  # Returns an array containing the items in the range.
  #
  #   (1..7).to_a  #=> [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]
  #   (1..).to_a   #=> RangeError: cannot convert endless range to an array
  def to_a
    a = __num_to_a
    return a if a
    super
  end
  alias entries to_a
end
